subject.title: Modular Dashboard: agent-composable Control UI workspaces (tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the modular dashboard workspace stack as a bundled Control UI product direction, and under what storage and security boundaries?
rationale: The request adds a default-facing dashboard model, persistent workspace state, Gateway RPC/event surfaces, agent tools, and untrusted browser widget execution; code inspection alone cannot decide whether that belongs in bundled OpenClaw now.

options.title: Review and sponsor the stack
options.body: Proceed through the three linked PRs in order, requiring fixes for storage-policy, security-boundary, upgrade, and proof concerns before merge.

options.title: Narrow to generic seams
options.body: Land only the plugin/API seams maintainers want, and keep dashboard-specific widgets/workspaces outside bundled core until sponsored.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the broader idea tracked or close the PR stack if maintainers decide this is not current roadmap work.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Proceed through the three linked PRs in order, requiring fixes for storage-policy, security-boundary, upgrade, and proof concerns before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history signal for the Control UI direction and the plugin-tab seam this proposal builds on.
